title: Prove the labelling flow on a bundle with the À répondre example

proofs.run: name the bundle label of the build the run used (the acceptance says 'the main49 bundle', which is an old label: any main bundle that holds the A140 fixture counts) and read the example's figures from the run's lines as counts: picks, accepts, keeps, to Primary, waiting

owner: The owner opens the inspector of the label À répondre on their own Mac, in a bundle the lead names, and says the three cards read as the example says (their eyes, their word). The lead cannot give that.
notes: What the acceptance asks versus what exists. The acceptance's figures (entry rule catches 1, AI sorts 31, exit keeps 23, 8 go to Primary) are the figures before SPEC A140 (docs/SPEC.md:158). The fixture's example now reads 37 picked by step 1, 32 accepted by the AI, 24 kept by step 3, 8 sent to the fallback (Primary), 5 waiting for the AI (docs/lanes/flow3-swift.md section 5, from docs/design/fixtures/mac-main-sample.json `flow_example`; pinned in checks/parity/par-labelscontactsmac.py:929 EX_PINNED, derived by example_figures() at :928, the self-test holds the two equal and the mutant above breaks the pin). 31 + 1 = 32 is the same total of AI-or-entry filed mails; 23 + 1 kept is 24. This is a question for the owner/lead: confirm the A140 figures replace the old ones. Judges: par-labelscontactsmac.py EXAMPLE list (:2640-2650) prints one 'name  pass|fail|unjudged  detail' line per case via report() (:2968-2973): a140-step-1-picks-37 (e_entry), a140-the-ai-accepts-32 (e_ai), a140-the-exit-filter-keeps-24 (e_kept), a140-8-go-to-primary (e_primary), a140-a-reply-moves-one-message-out-of-the-label (e_reply, 'a reply moves one out'), a140-5-picked-mails-wait-for-the-ai, a140-no-warning-says-the-ai-will-see-none, a140-the-example-row-step-1-once-filed-is-now-exit. Each has its own mutant in the self-test (proof 1), e.g. entry-count-wrong, ai-count-wrong, kept-count-wrong, primary-count-wrong, reply-keeps-it-in. The reader's finding ('NOT BUILT': the string main49 appears only in audit files) is true of the label 'main49': no run on that bundle exists; the checks and the fixture rows exist at this commit, so proof 0 is the first run. The hidden run uses the fixture core on a bundle the lead builds (scripts/launch-one.sh, WHOOSH_RIG_HIDDEN=1).
